policy.faceLandmarkRule: alpha top to detected chin skin boundary
policy.opticalFaceRule: median visible skin width and area by down, left, and right direction
policy.opticalHeadRule: fixed head silhouette width and front/profile median ratio
policy.opticalLandmarkRule: median visible face center and chin anchors by visible direction
policy.motionRule: symmetric first and third steps, matched side stride, stable center and baseline
policy.fourStepGaitRule: frames 1 and 3 visibly alternate feet; frames 2 and 4 are distinct neutral load-transfer poses
policy.guest01AccessoryRule: the complete upper body and handbag band is pixel-locked within each direction
policy.guest01FootGeometryRule: profile landing frames share one natural shoe silhouette and alternate leg depth without bending or mirroring the shoes
policy.guest03ProportionRule: the complete head, chin, and shoulder band is pixel-locked across all four walk frames within each direction
policy.guest03SuitIntegrityRule: leg phase emphasis starts below the intact jacket and alternates trouser shading without mirroring shoes

policy.measurementBand: head and upper 48 percent of body
